description: Edge case: uptime missing, but governance_participation and ecosystem_contribution both at 1.0. Pins two behaviors: (1) re-normalization produces a perfect 1.0 composite from only the two available factors (0.3 + 0.3) / 0.6 = 1.0; (2) below_uptime_minimum does NOT fire because the check is guarded by `resolvedFactors.uptime !== null`. Missing data should not be treated as bad data.
